text:
Maria: heads-up — I noticed a small but consistent chunk of traffic without a version header is getting attributed to v2 quotas in billing-snapshots. :thinking:
Devin: :eyes: saw that too in the nightly audit. spikes around 03:00 UTC, looks like requests missing `x-client-version` fall through to the default route which maps to v2.
Sasha: are these coming from legacy mobile SDKs or proxies? any common user-agent?
Maria: some are mobile, some look like server-to-server whitelisted keys. UA is mixed. here's the log pattern:
```
route_map.apply(request) -> default
if not request.headers['x-client-version']:
  // earlier we returned 'unknown' but new router returns 'v2'
```
Devin: that snippet matches; the router refactor consolidated unknown -> latest variant to avoid 404s. unintended quota side-effect.
Ryan: oof. We intentionally collapsed unknown -> latest for UX, but forgot quota attribution mapping. We should not silently bill unknown as v2.
Anita: agreed. Two quick asks: 1) can we patch router to use an "unknown-version" bucket for accounting (cheap) and 2) can console surface this bucket so customers see it?
Sasha: +1. For telemetry we should sample full traces for 1% of unknown hits and aggregate counters for the rest — gives visibility without high cardinality.
Devin: implementation notes: add a router-label `version_hint: unknown` and pipe that into quota attribution. Also emit `sampling_hint: full` for sampled requests.
Maria: that covers infra. from product/console POV, what should the UI show? a toast? a badge?
Anita: show a little badge in the per-route quota panel: "unattributed / unknown" with a link to docs. Also add a toggle to reassign unknown hits to a chosen fallback (v1/v2) for a bounded window — only in tenant admin.
Ryan: reassign toggle is powerful but risky — needs audit log and cooldown. Also make default false.
Sasha: on telemetry clickthrough, include small example queries for customer support: "count by version_hint where version_hint='unknown'" and a sample rate column.
Devin: question: if we create unknown bucket, do we retroactively correct historical billing snapshots?
Maria: we should not change past invoices. But for internal dashboards and rollout metrics, we can backfill a best-effort cohort label via logs for last 30 days and mark them as estimated.
Anita: ops/finance: backfill estimate + separate ledger entry flagged as "reclassified (estimate)" — avoid altering charged invoices.
Ryan: engineering plan:
- hotfix router to emit `version_hint: unknown` for header-less requests (low-risk)
- add quota pipeline mapping for unknown -> account but not mapped to v2
- add 1% full-trace sampling + 10% aggregate counters
- console: add badge + admin reassign toggle (audit + cooldown)
Devin: I'll open an RFC and assign owners. Can someone own the console copy and UX mock? @Sasha?
Sasha: happy to own copy & mock. will do a small mock by EOD.
Maria: thanks. @deploy-bot can you run a quick smoke test when router patch is staged?
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for pr/4921. smoke-run scheduled. :rocket:
Anita: follow-ups: 1) inform CS & billing about unknown bucket and non-retro billing policy, 2) add docs FAQ for reassign toggle consequences.
Ryan: timeline: hotfix today, quota plumbing tomorrow, console next sprint.
Devin: RFC: 7167771234-v1-unknown-version-accounting-proposal (link coming).
Maria: nice. one more tiny ask — add a metric `unknown_version_fraction` per-tenant so we can alert if fraction > 2% for > 1h.
Sasha: will include that in mock and graphs.
Devin: thanks all. if anyone spots a customer panic, ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks — feel better having this surfaced.
Ryan: closing loop: add unit test for router fallback semantics (`header missing -> version_hint=unknown`) and integration test for quota attribution.
Anita: noted.
Maria: end.
